item.title: At least 3 dead, 6 others injured after car crashes into Westwood grocery store
item.description: At least three people were killed and six others were injured after a car crashed into a 99 Ranch Market in Westwood.

item.title: Residents at Redlands nudist resort accuse landlord of disconnecting electricity as retaliation
item.description: Tensions are boiling at the Olive Dell Ranch in Redlands after some residents say the owners are retaliating against them by cutting off their power.

item.title: Dodgers reportedly planning White House visit to celebrate World Series win
item.description: The Dodgers are reportedly getting ready for another visit to the White House to commemorate their 2025 World Series championship.

item.title: LAFD lobbies city leaders for regulations as lithium-ion battery fires rise
item.description: As lithium-ion batteries power more of our everyday tools, the Los Angeles Fire Department warns the batteries are also supercharging more fires.

item.title: A 101-year-old man's Los Feliz home was burglarized as he slept. The intruder left behind his fedora
item.description: A fedora-wearing burglar accused of breaking into the home of a 101-year-old Los Feliz man has been arrested after police say they found him inside the victim's car.

item.title: Bad Bunny says he will bring his culture to 2026 Super Bowl halftime performance
item.description: Bad Bunny says he's approaching his highly anticipated halftime performance with a mix of excitement, gratitude and perspective.

item.title: Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford wins NFL MVP award
item.description: Matthew Stafford edged Drake Maye for the AP NFL Most Valuable Player award in the closest race since Peyton Manning and Steve McNair were co-winners in 2003.

item.title: Family of man shot and killed by police in Santa Ana files claim against city
item.description: The family of a man who was shot and killed by police in Santa Ana last week has filed a claim against the city, claiming the officer who was involved used excessive force and did not follow his training.

item.title: SoCal to see mild Friday as warmer temps return Super Bowl Sunday
item.description: Southern California gets a break from the heat Friday, but temperatures start to warm up again during the weekend.

item.title: Torrance man arrested for demanding Bitcoin ransom from Guthrie family
item.description: The man allegedly used an app to create a fake phone number to text the family, according to a federal complaint.
